rows.ARS:
Pink blend Grandiflora.
Registration name: WILdels
Exhibition name: Delany Sisters
rows.Origin:
Bred by J. Benjamin Williams (United States, 1997).
Introduced in United States by J.B. Williams and Associates in 1997 as 'Delany Sisters'.
rows.Bloom: Pink blend. Strong fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Parentage:
Love (grandiflora, Warriner, 1977) ×
Händel (Large Flowered Climber, McGredy 1960)
